evidence: Partial remediation: current Table 1 enumerates all 12 anchors and recorded recipes; the new receipt records source hashes, model strings, run IDs, subset membership and fit parameters. This authenticates arithmetic only. Exact checkpoint revisions, prompt IDs, backend/decoding/stopping metadata and a frozen archive remain unavailable; console probes remain unauthenticated. Section 2 explicitly discloses these limits. Do not treat this finding as fully closed.

Recomputed the note's bounded three-parameter fits and separate model-free mean rewards after excluding Nemotron. Table 3 reports slopes, 95% conditional OLS intervals, df and two-sided permutation diagnostics on 11 anchors and six long traces. All intervals contain zero. The review's suspected positive size-trend reversal is not supported; the nominal one-sided architecture comparison is a different statistic. Receipt and generator are now checked in.

Section 4 calls plateau/drift/collapse descriptive labels, not a validated taxonomy; Table 1 supplies first-step rewards and Section 2 discloses ceiling and recipe/horizon confounding. No systematic taxonomy is claimed.

Current Section 3 contains model/test definitions and table references; workflow directives are removed. Section 2 links the public repository, now provides an executable audit and explicitly disclaims a frozen archival release.

Section 2 defines N as nominal total parameters, not active parameters or compute, and identifies Nemotron as LatentMoE with 120B total and 12B active. New receipt preserves total and active counts without changing the total-parameter regressor.

Abstract and table captions subordinate diagnostics to evidence limitations and expressly reject flatness and causal architecture conclusions. Section 1 says all anchors are single-seed and the internal iteration ledger is not an immutable preregistration.

Section 3 now explicitly describes conditional OLS intervals that do not propagate fit uncertainty, anchor-level units, n-2 df and the lack of guaranteed exchangeability under recipe/family confounding. Table 2 labels boundary-driven tests uninformative, not evidence of flatness.

Section 3 gives the joint saturation form, historical and bounded-refit constraints and permutation statistic. Released generator reproduces the note-specific non-monotone offset fit (not the longer manuscript's monotone fit). Corrected Table 2 boundary split from four/four to five upper and three lower, and corrected two rounded interval endpoints.

Current Table 2 scopes the historical constant-model preference to five 20-30-step traces and reports the separate 40-step audit as a boundary on the claim, not a cross-scale anchor. No per-family AICc result is used to infer size flatness.

Table 2 defines the dependent variable as per-anchor trace-mean reward and the statistic as MoE-minus-dense group mean. Reproduced corrected 7v5 gap +0.1875095, one-sided p=141/792; without Nemotron 6v5 +0.2781889, one-sided p=22/462 and two-sided p=43/462; long7 4v3 +0.0201389, one-sided p=20/35. Post-hoc multiplicity, recipe, ceiling and probe limitations are stated.

The prior committed revision added eight inline-cited bibliography entries and a positioning paragraph. Verified that all eight cite keys resolve to embedded bibitems; this pass adds no new citations and does not redo bibliographic verification.
Current Table 1 and Table 2 use Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B; shortened Nemotron in nearby prose and file paths is unambiguous.
Current note consistently describes saturation fits/rates and distinguishes the within-trace rate from the cross-scale slope; it does not claim a universal saturation exponent.
Corrected Akaike information criterion is expanded at first use; elevation-suite jargon is removed.
Both regression tables explicitly use log10 N; the rate outcome is log10 lambda, not raw lambda or raw N.

Table 2 now prints exact architecture tail counts and denominators, and Section 3 distinguishes exact n! enumeration from 10,000 Monte Carlo permutations with plus-one correction. Table 3 p-values are consistently rounded to three decimals.
Section 3 has explanatory prose before Table 2, and the new sensitivity paragraph references Table 3. Final PDF is checked separately for placement and overflow.
